set.body: Goal: a concise, typed entry surface for domain modules (design, motion, connectivity, group) that composes Plot/Layer/scales/theme without exposing compiler internals: e.g. plot(data).aes(x, y, color).geomLine().scaleColorDiscrete(...).theme(...) returning Either. Acceptance: DSL builds only valid plots (invalid states unrepresentable or typed errors); DesignGraphics reimplemented on the DSL with unchanged output; docs example per domain module; JVM+JS tests.
set.title: Graphics: user-facing plotting DSL
